title: Genealogy_Death_Definitions
description: Standard definitions for mortality, medical certification, and etiology records.

cause_of_death.description: Structured medical certification detailing manner, primary, antecedent, and contributory causes of death.

immediate_cause.description: Primary disease or condition directly resulting in death.

antecedent_causes.description: Sequentially underlying morbid conditions leading up to the immediate cause.

contributory_causes.description: Other significant conditions contributing to death but not resulting in the underlying cause.

interval_onset.description: Verbatim duration between onset and death.

autopsy_performed.description: Indicates whether a post-mortem surgical examination was conducted.

findings_considered.description: Indicates whether autopsy findings were utilized in determining the cause of death.
